taglines: Building security tools for AI systems
Finding accessibility barriers on the web
Reproducing ML research on a single CPU

projects.name: IntentShield
projects.description: Layered threat detection with explainable evidence, a central ALLOW / WARN / REVIEW / BLOCK policy, an evaluation lab and an optional gateway to a local LLM.

projects.name: AccessLens
projects.description: Renders pages in Chromium, runs axe-core WCAG checks, keeps screenshot evidence and scan history, and exports PDF, DOCX, CSV and JSON reports.

projects.name: MedEvo Evaluation Study
projects.summary: Independent reproduction of a medical reasoning method
projects.description: Reimplements the MedEvo self-correction loop on one CPU. LoRA adaptation of Qwen3.5-2B raised strict accuracy from 21.5% to 50.0% on VQA-RAD and SLAKE.

projects.name: CampusFind
projects.description: Student reports, private ownership claims, administrator review and confirmed returns, with a handover queue and a full decision history.
